mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over 3-year rolling windows, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply contraction (INDPRO < 100), reduced corporate capacity utilization leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts over the prior 3 months signals expanding residential construction, boosting consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of HOUST rising trend instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) signals Fed tightening pressure, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate labor market tightness that triggers wage inflation and Fed policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over 3-year rolling windows, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth deceleration (GDPC1 QoQ < 0.5%) signals slowing economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of GDPC1 QoQ < 0.5% periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
